patches.decision_note: An NFT's permanent code identity, eligibility of an entered code, and valid/invalid UI feedback have separate acceptance criteria and failure trajectories.
Recording only successful mints and delivering the resulting NFT can fail and be verified independently.

requirements.title: Total Supply and Mint Sequence Accuracy

patches.decision_note: Displaying a wallet's NFT holdings is independently testable from reporting total supply and the current mint sequence.
Resolving an NFT's metadata and image assets is independent from keeping its live referral, ticket, commission, badge, and earnings attributes accurate.

replacement.title: Removable IPFS Ebook Hosting
replacement.definition: Host the ebook PDF through Pinata/IPFS while preserving the client's requested ability to remove the hosted content later.

patches.decision_note: The requested hosting and later removal capability is an independent storage behavior, not an NFT-ownership gating rule.

replacement.title: NFT Detail-Page Book Cover Presentation
replacement.definition: Display the book cover fully and at an appropriate size on the NFT detail page.

patches.decision_note: The NFT detail-page cover has its own failure, implementation-claim, and verification trajectory distinct from the landing-page cover.

replacement.title: Landing-Page Mechanics Copy
replacement.definition: Present the approved referral-commission and recurring $500-prize mechanics accurately in non-hero landing-page sections.

patches.decision_note: Prize and referral wording outside the hero changes independently from hero layout and book-cover presentation.
Site availability is a standalone operational behavior and shares no coherent business mechanism with Blockaid verification or contract-event ingestion.
Blockaid verification is a specific security-warning remediation task rather than a sibling of site availability and webhook ingestion.
Contract-event ingestion is an independent backend integration; PRODUCTION_OPERATIONS otherwise functions as a catch-all Family.
Identifying a selected wallet does not verify that both the required $5 commission and prize ticket were awarded.
The rewards had not been finalized, so their absence from NFT attributes does not independently establish a metadata defect.

execution.observed_behavior: The client reports completing the webhook configuration, but this message does not report a delivered contract event or successful backend processing.

patches.decision_note: Completing configuration is an implementation-status claim, not runtime verification that contract logs are captured and routed successfully.
